entities.name: Fetch a file of the game
entities.description: The page, its script, its styles or its icon, for an invited player.
entities.authorization: AUTH.requireRole(req, env, "games:lundey"): icelander.net's site_session cookie, checked with the login service through the ACCOUNTS binding.
entities.result: The file from the static assets, with Cache-Control private, no-cache for an HTML page and private, max-age=3600 for anything else.
failures: 301 to /games/lundey/ for the bare address /games/lundey, keeping the query; answered before the sign-in is looked at.
404 Not found for a path outside /games/lundey/; answered before the sign-in is looked at.
405 Method not allowed, with Allow: GET, HEAD, for any other method; answered before the sign-in is looked at.
302 to /auth/sign-in?return=<the address asked for> when the visitor is not signed in.
403 with the not-invited page, never cached (private, no-store), when the player is signed in without games:lundey.
The static assets' own 404, to an invited player, for a file the build did not make.

relatedViews.relationship: How the files are guarded and cached.
What the player does once the page has been fetched.
